title: Children of InstantSearchNext are being duplicated
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

When using InstantSearchNext in the layout, its child components are being duplicated. This issue did not occur previously and seems to have appeared after the fix for #6479 was implemented.

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

1. Open the homepage
2. Scroll down
3. Observe that the "Click" button appears twice. The first instance does not function, while the second one works as expected

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/devbox/algolia-next-bug-duplicated-provider-content-2ht5yj

### 💭 Expected behavior

The child components of InstantSearchNext should not be duplicated.

### Package version

next 15.0.4, react-instantsearch-nextjs 0.4.4, algoliasearch 5.17.1, react-instantsearch 7.13.8

### Operating system

_No response_

### Browser

_No response_

comments.body: I’m experiencing the same issue with InstantSearchNext duplicating child components. Let me know if any additional details would help!

Hey all, I checked and this is due to having `<InstantSearchNext>` with no InstantSearch widgets inside.

We assume there will always be some as all our documentation and examples have `<InstantSearch>` not in layout but on the page itself, with widgets inside. Technically we don't try to support having it in the layout.

In the meantime you could add a `useHits()` or some other hook to ensure you at least have a widget and it should work I believe. I'll try to debug this but it seems like a weird hydration problem that's somehow not raised by Next.js.

@AmeerSapadmi I edited your CodeSandbox, just put a searchbox that doesn't render in `AlgoliaProvider` and it works : https://codesandbox.io/p/devbox/algolia-next-bug-duplicated-provider-content-forked-hkvls5?file=/app/components/AlgoliaProvider.tsx
